To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

professional development should be: • sustained; • focused on content, pedagogy, and the context in which teachers work; • collegial, with the opportunity for teachers to interact with other teachers; • focused on the teachers' needs and concerns; • focused on learning rather than teaching; and • focused on improving student learning.

effective professional development: • is an ongoing process of learning and development that is embedded in the work of the school; • provides opportunities for teachers to work collaboratively, with peers and with others, to develop, implement and refine instructional practices; • is focused on the specific content and skills that teachers are expected to teach; and • includes opportunities for teachers to reflect on and revise their own practice.

professional development programs for mathematics and science teachers should be designed to have a clear focus, should provide teachers with opportunities for active learning, and should be sustained over time.
In summary, our research is concerned with
how professional development can be used to help teachers improve the teaching of mathematics, science and the integration of the two.
the question of how professional development can be designed and implemented to help teachers improve student achievement.
the development of a theory of effective professional development for mathematics and science education.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there is no single, simple, and universal prescription for professional development.
professional development is a critical element in improving the quality of mathematics and science education.

professional development is a critical component of the educational process, and that the standards and guidelines for effective professional development should be used to guide the development of all professional development activities for mathematics and science teachers.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the standards of professional development for mathematics and science teachers should include: 1.
professional development is a critical component in improving the teaching and learning of mathematics and science.

professional development is a critical element in the improvement of student learning in mathematics and science, and that it should be based on standards for professional development that are grounded in the standards for teaching and student learning.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the most effective professional development is that which engages teachers in the work of teaching and learning, and is grounded in the subject matter.
professional development for teachers should focus on improving student learning.
professional development must be grounded in principles that support teachers’ learning and the improvement of their practice.
